---
title: "Map"
---

The first map covers County Dublin. It puts every likely Catholic Church site in the county on one map, from open data: OpenStreetMap, the National Inventory of Architectural Heritage, the four Dublin councils' Records of Protected Structures, the Department of Education school lists and institutions named in the official reports.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Every point is a grade D lead
A point says *where* a church, convent or school is, not *who owns it*. No open dataset records ownership. Each site still has to be checked against its Land Registry folio before it moves up the evidence grades; see [Method](method.qmd).
:::

Toggle sources in the layer list. Click a point for its source record.
